name: Luck pocket
summary: A 'wish me luck' story drawn as a jacket pocket; friends drop one good-luck charm each (clover, horseshoe, a tiny car, star, heart, coffee) with one word, and afterwards the author adds one sticker, sun, half sun or cloud, and every charm dances.
useWhen: first date tonight wish me luck, make my story something
will has a job interview tomorrow, let everyone send good luck
good luck charms for maya's driving test
story where friends drop little charms for luck
lowkey nervous for tonight, put a luck thing on my story
dontUseWhen: asking friends for advice or opinions on the date (send a message)
a bet on how it goes (do not build one)
celebrating after it went well (use bday-candles or a reaction)

author.description: Whose story it is; only they add the sticker afterwards

ago.description: How long ago it went up, e.g. '2h'

caption.description: Text on the story, in their words

car.description: What the little car charm is called, e.g. 'tiny Sube'

charms.description: Charms already dropped, one per friend, each with one word
